why: Asks whether the BARREL OPENING is clear rather than whether the region the shell will occupy is -- the exact confusion splitting the two constants introduced. It both refuses shots that fit and, worse, misses a wall sitting in the span the shell is actually born into, which spawns a live shell inside solid geometry.
killedBy: spawnBullet + ownerShellCount spawns a bullet with config speed/bounces and emits a fire event
spawnBullet: muzzleClearsTanks (adopted ruling, 2026-08-14: "spawn at hull centre" switch) OFF: restores the old behaviour -- the shell spawns already inside the neighbour
spawnBullet: muzzleClearsTanks (adopted ruling, 2026-08-14: "spawn at hull centre" switch) ON, but the neighbour is already dead: a corpse never blocks a muzzle, switch or not
spawnBullet: the muzzle plane vs the shell centre (issue #237) holds the nose on the plane at every firing angle, and off a moving tank
spawnBullet: the muzzle plane vs the shell centre (issue #237) retreats for a wall that covers the shell but NOT the barrel opening
spawnBullet: the muzzle plane vs the shell centre (issue #237) tests clearance where the SHELL will be, not at the barrel opening
spawnBullet: where the shell is born spawns at the muzzle, offset along the FIRING angle not the body
spawnBullet: where the shell is born still uses the muzzle when the wall is behind the tank
